name: PostgreSQL
description: Import any standard PostgreSQL database (not only Supabase): pg_catalog-native inspection of schemas, tables, columns with exact type preservation, views, materialized views, indexes, constraints, sequences, functions, procedures, triggers, extensions, enums, domains, generated columns, partitioning and large objects; read-only session enforced; batched keyset extraction with deterministic resume. No source mutation.
author: TEMM Nexus (first-party)

ui.setup_instructions: Provide host, port, database, username and password. Use a least-privilege READ-ONLY role (CONNECT + SELECT on the schemas to import); the connector additionally enforces read-only sessions. Unknown extension types are flagged NEEDS_REVIEW rather than silently approximated.
